raw_response:
This bar chart illustrates the distribution of participant counts across different criteria. The vertical axis displays the criteria labels: “Relevant FCs”, “FC Summary”, “Relevance Explanation”, “Clarity and Simplicity”, “Overall Summary”, “Filters”, and “Veracity Explanation”, listed in that order from top to bottom. The horizontal axis, labeled “Number of Participants”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at intervals of 2. Each criterion is represented by a horizontal bar colored in shades of teal and green. The “Relevant FCs” bar is the longest, extending to a value of approximately 6, while “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation” are the shortest, each reaching a value of 1. The “FC Summary” bar extends to a value of 5, and “Relevance Explanation”, “Clarity and Simplicity”, and “Overall Summary” each reach a value of 3 and 2 respectively. The bars are arranged in descending order based on the number of participants, with the exception of the last two criteria. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
